name: print-social-digital-marketing-agency-story-pink-purple-gradient-50-off
title: 'Digital Marketing Agency' story with a pink-purple gradient, cream rounded card and bold '50% off' corner
whatItMeans: Bold and legible; a rounded cream card floating over a vivid gradient keeps a busy offer story easy to read.
whatItIs: A vertical pink-to-purple gradient story with a rounded cream card holding a bold two-tone 'Digital Marketing Agency' headline, a bulleted service list (Website Design, Social Media Marketing, Graphic Design, Mail Marketing, SEO), a black 'Enroll Now' button, and a large 'Now OFF 50%' callout in mixed colours and weights.
techniques: Float a rounded content card over a vivid gradient background.
Mix multiple colours and weights within one discount callout.
Bracket the card with corner brackets for a 'premium' framing detail.

vocabulary.definition: A distinct panel holding the main message, floated over a background.
A small L-shaped mark framing a corner, borrowed from camera viewfinders.
